name: naturenergie holding AG
summary: naturenergie holding AG, leveraging its various subsidiaries, is active in the energy sector, encompassing the generation, distribution, and sale of electricity under its "naturenergie" brand, serving customers in Switzerland and internationally. The company's electricity production primarily utilizes hydroelectric, solar, and hydrogen sources. Beyond its core power business, it offers an array of services including gas supply, heating systems, housing solutions, and mobility options, such as car sharing and charging station infrastructure. Its operations also extend to the construction, management, and upkeep of distribution networks, as well as the planning, development, and maintenance of combined heat and power plants. Additionally, the firm designs and installs electrical systems, undertakes roof renovations, integrates photovoltaic systems with energy storage capabilities, and develops and deploys smart home control technologies. Founded in 1894 and headquartered in Laufenburg, Switzerland, the company rebranded from Energiedienst Holding AG to naturenergie holding AG in May 2024. It functions as a subsidiary of EnBW Energie Baden-Württemberg AG.
